description: This file implements helper functions for configuring and validating CSI (Channel State Information) resources and reporting in a 5G NR scheduler, including CSI-RS, NZP-CSI-RS, and CSI measurement configurations, adhering to 3GPP TS 38.331 and TS 38.214 specifications.

methods.name: get_csi_freq_occupation_rbs
methods.description: Calculates the RB interval over which a CSI resource spans based on the number of CRBs and BWP width.

methods.name: get_max_csi_rs_period
methods.description: Computes the maximum CSI-RS signaling period constrained by TS 38.214.

methods.name: is_csi_rs_period_valid
methods.description: Validates if a CSI-RS period is a multiple of the TDD period and matches allowed durations.

methods.name: find_valid_csi_rs_period
methods.description: Finds a valid CSI-RS period that is compatible with the TDD configuration.

methods.name: derive_valid_csi_rs_slot_offsets
methods.description: Determines valid CSI-RS slot offsets ensuring no collision with SIB1, SSB, and UL slots.

methods.name: make_default_zp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Creates a default Zero-Power CSI-RS resource with specified parameters.

methods.name: make_periodic_zp_csi_rs_resource_list
methods.description: Generates a list containing one periodic Zero-Power CSI-RS resource.

methods.name: make_periodic_zp_csi_rs_resource_set
methods.description: Creates a resource set containing the Zero-Power CSI-RS resource.

methods.name: convert_csi_resource_period_to_report_period
methods.description: Converts CSI resource periodicity to a suitable CSI report periodicity.

methods.name: make_common_nzp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Fills common fields for NZP-CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_channel_measurement_nzp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Creates a NZP-CSI-RS resource for channel measurement with specific parameters.

methods.name: fill_tracking_nzp_csi_rs_resource
methods.description: Populates a set of NZP-CSI-RS resources for tracking purposes.

methods.name: make_nzp_csi_rs_resource_list
methods.description: Generates a list of NZP-CSI-RS resources including measurement and tracking resources.

methods.name: make_nzp_csi_rs_resource_sets
methods.description: Creates resource sets for NZP-CSI-RS measurement and tracking.

methods.name: get_subcarrier_location_from_fd_alloc_bit_location
methods.description: Determines subcarrier location from frequency domain allocation bit position.

methods.name: make_csi_im_resources
methods.description: Creates CSI-IM resources matching the ZP-CSI-RS resources.

methods.name: make_csi_im_resource_sets
methods.description: Creates CSI-IM resource set.

methods.name: make_csi_resource_configs
methods.description: Creates CSI resource configurations for measurement, interference, and tracking.

methods.name: make_csi_report_configs
methods.description: Generates CSI report configurations based on parameters and PUSCH allocations.

methods.name: make_csi_meas_config
methods.description: Constructs a complete CSI measurement configuration with resources, report configs, and optional aperiodic settings.
